entry.title: Ramp Data Shows AI Spending Stalling as Token Volumes Rise
entry.content:

A new report from corporate card platform Ramp indicates that business spending on artificial intelligence flatlined over late summer despite rising token volumes. According to the data, token spend grew by only 1.5% across August and September, following a 42% jump in July, driven by increased price competition among model providers and more cost-conscious enterprise purchasing behaviors.

The slowdown coincides with preparations for Anthropic's initial public offering and a broader recalibration of growth expectations across the industry. While demand for AI remains high and token usage continues to climb, price cuts from major providers like OpenAI and Anthropic, combined with the adoption of efficient routing tools and cheaper open-source models, have compressed revenue growth for leading AI companies.
